components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:32px;min-height:60px;padding:8px 8px 8px 18px;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 10%,rgba(255,255,255,.8) 100%);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);box-shadow:0 12px 12px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.1),0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.06),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.58);transform:translateY(20px);transition:background .18s ease-out,transform .16s ease-out;font:1rem Onest,sans-serif}.ds-nav.ds-scrolled{transform:none}.ds-nav a{color:rgba(17,20,38,.88);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav .ds-header-cta{background:#17233d;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 20px}.ds-header-cta:hover{background:#283956}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #6e91ff;outline-offset:5px}@supports not (backdrop-filter:blur(12px)){.ds-nav{background:rgba(255,255,255,.98)}}

narrative.overview: The approved Studio uses neutral-white pages, navy and blue text, Onest typography, purple pill actions, portraits and concrete work examples. This replaces the retired dark/cyan design reference; it does not authorize a new visual direction.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral-white canvas with pale supporting fields.
Navy body/headings, blue emphasis and purple actions remain distinct.
One Onest role scale; fully pill-shaped action controls.
Translucent floating navigation at both the top and after scrolling.
dos: Use the current Studio cascade and route-specific overrides as the implementation authority.
Keep concrete role scope, price, permissions and next actions readable.
Label illustrative demonstrations; retain keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not restore the old dark/cyan system, Inter hierarchy or retired surface concepts.
Do not turn the header opaque on scroll or recolor all blue text purple.
Do not use generic „ясна/реална“ filler in scope copy; name the task, systems, permitted actions and approval conditions.
Do not invent customer evidence, universal integration support or a fixed-price custom subscription.
